subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A new bench was placed under the old tree in the park.”?
options: It sits near the door and plays songs from many years ago.
A young mother often stopped near the bench while her baby slept.
After the poster was placed near the office, students began turning off lights more often.
While the young man fixed the guitar, the old man told a short story about his band many years ago.

本文可直接核對「A young mother often stopped near the bench while her baby slept.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「After the poster was placed near the office, students began turning off lights more often.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
